milestones.name: Make real verification the felt default — close the gap between the enforcement wedge and the mock default
milestones.objective: CADENCE's sharpest, most-defensible differentiator (a deterministic in-loop AC-linked gate that refuses to settle) currently ships with its WEAKEST implementation on by default: the mock verifier only checks that a linked test exists and references the AC. The public pitch is 'real verification gate'; the out-of-box experience is 'structural test-linkage'. Decide how to converge them — e.g. make 'cadence activate' (v1.22) a near-mandatory first-run step, surface a louder 'you are running mock = NOT real verification' state in settle/doctor/quickstart, and/or reframe docs so mock is explicitly named as a placeholder, not a verifier. This is the #1 strategic finding from the 2026-06-11 competitive assessment: the wedge and the default experience must stop diverging.

milestones.name: Zero-prompt init that auto-wires the host
milestones.objective: cadence init prompts for name (default 'unnamed') + profile, then tells the user to separately run the host install. Derive name from package.json/dir, profile from git (suggestGateProfile already exists), detect .claude/ and offer/auto-run host install in the same step. --name/--preset stay as overrides. One command, zero questions, fully wired.

milestones.name: init --demo: pre-filled first phase in the real repo
milestones.objective: cadence tutorial runs in a throwaway sandbox then deletes it - user ends with nothing. README quickstart says 'fill .cadence/phases/.../DRAFT.md' - that hand-edit is the cliff. Scaffold a real phase with objective + AC-1 + task T1 already written (reuse tutorial toy template, tutorial.ts:44-75) so the user runs approve -> done -> settle immediately and watches a real gate fire/pass in their own repo.

milestones.name: Auto-derive phase id and collapse --ac syntax
milestones.objective: cadence draft new 01-foundation 01 --title needs kebab-case + zero-padded positionals (error-prone); resolveNextFreePhase already computes next-free. Make positionals optional: draft new --title auto-fills phase/num. settle run --ac AC-1=pass AC-2=fail:reason colon syntax is cryptic - add --pass-all / --ac-pass shorthands. Make cadence progress print one clean copy-pasteable next command.

milestones.name: Fold activation into init when API key present
milestones.objective: Out-of-box mock verifier is plastered as 'NOT real verification' across init/doctor/config-explain, but turning it on is a separate cadence activate + export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY dance. At init, if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is already in env, offer (or --activate auto-select) anthropic right there. User with key gets real verification with zero extra hops and no scolding.

milestones.name: Agent/non-TTY mode to kill the StdinPrompter minefield
milestones.objective: Approve gate, activate, and the settle interactive gate all block in non-TTY with cryptic 'StdinPrompter: stdin is not a TTY' errors; the fix flags (--no-approve, --no-interactive) are buried in small init-output text. Primary driver is AI agents = always non-TTY. Detect non-TTY at init (or --preset agent): set auto gate profile + non-blocking loop defaults, emit agent-ready command snippets. Removes the whole error class on first run.

milestones.name: Draft templates for first real work
milestones.objective: Add first-task templates such as `bugfix`, `feature`, and `refactor` for `cadence draft new`, generating useful Objective, AC, Tasks, and Boundaries scaffolds from a title. This closes the remaining cliff after users understand the loop: what to type for the first real DRAFT.

milestones.name: Boundary enforcement block mode, including subagent edits
milestones.objective: DRAFT declares files: per task and Boundaries per phase, but pre-tool-edit checks only warn, the sole blocking edit hook is off by default, and subagent edits only tick a counter. Fix: boundaryEnforcement warn|block config (default warn); block mode refuses out-of-boundary writes at edit time where the host supports it, and a settle-time diff scan raises a blocking anomaly for out-of-boundary changes everywhere — honest scoping for hosts where edit-time hooks cannot see subagents.
